proof.text: Only finitely many rank components meet a quasi-compact target open. On each such component, the finitely presented rank loci for the module and its dual, and their fibre product, are quasi-compact. The pieces glue by the universal property, and a finite union of quasi-compact pieces is quasi-compact; quasi-compactness of an immersion is local on the target.
